d: Portugal tried to celebrate Cristiano Ronaldo, but the man himself wasn't even there. What followed in Braga was hardly the farewell anyone would have imagined: a 4-1 defeat against Denmark, angry supporters, loud boos and Jorge Jesus' rather cold response when asked if Portugal missed their former captain. The contrast with Lionel Messi's emotional Argentina farewell was impossible to ignore. After years of comparing Messi and Ronaldo, their goodbyes have offered a very different talking point.
